mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as rising demand signals economic expansion and investor optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 increasing over the horizon, or GDPC1 growth plateaus.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing above 4.0% triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as rising unemployment expectations signal labor market weakening and reduced consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.0% in next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing above 4.0%, or UNRATE reverts below 4.0% within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS falls below 2% and GDPC1 exceeds 20246 (current quarterly demand), the combination signals accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the joint signal, or either FEDFUNDS remains ≥2% or GDPC1 ≤20246 during the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle demand expansion regime, sustained high HOUST (demand) predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as rising demand outpaces supply constraints.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite HOUST remaining high in the regime, or the regime ends before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDPC1 exceeds 20246 (current level) and monthly INDPRO falls below 103 (current level), the imbalance between demand and supply signals inflationary pressures, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the demand-supply imbalance, or either GDPC1 ≤20246 or INDPRO ≥103 during the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL exceeding 305 triggers negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as rising inflation concerns prompt risk aversion and short-term selling.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 305, or CPIAUCSL reverts below 305 within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE falling below 3.5% triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as weakening labor market conditions reduce consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 3.5%, or UNRATE recovers above 3.5% within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS falls below 3% and UNRATE drops below 3.5%, the combination signals accommodative monetary policy and labor market softening, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the joint signal, or either FEDFUNDS ≥3% or UNRATE ≥3.5% during the horizon.
